element_1_the_discovery: V2 Retail Ltd presents strong aggregate revenue expansion (+65.3% YoY), yet growth is overwhelmingly propelled by aggressive new store footprint additions while network inventory expanded +309.3% (reaching ₹1,142 Cr), indicating that top-line acceleration masks maturing sales productivity across legacy flagship locations.
element_2_why_it_matters: Top-line revenue driven by new store openings can create an optical illusion of growth that masks maturing or cannibalized sales at existing locations.
Balance sheet inventory expanded by +309.3% to ₹1,142 Cr (holding period at 160.6 days), elevating markdown and obsolescence risks if footfalls normalize.
Substantial lease liabilities and store upfront capital investments require sustained high sales throughput per square foot to preserve store-level EBITDA margins.
Customer receivables remain nominal (0.2 days) due to cash-and-carry retail operations, concentrating operational risk squarely in inventory velocity.

element_6_counterargument: New retail store cohorts typically require 18 to 24 months to reach full sales maturity; near-term working capital absorption and inventory stocking are standard operational hallmarks of aggressive retail footprint scaling.
